subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept openai/codex-action 1.11 in its privileged agent workflows after an owner verifies the exact runtime and secret-handling contract, or should that update be split from the routine action bumps?
rationale: The PR changes action code that receives OpenAI credentials and repository-controlled prompts; the repository policy requires direct inspection of the sibling Codex source before a Codex-related verdict, and that evidence is not established here.

options.title: Split and review Codex separately
options.body: Land only the routine action bumps after normal workflow validation and keep the Codex-action revision in a focused security-reviewed PR.

options.title: Approve the grouped update
options.body: An owner may accept the grouped upgrade after directly verifying the Codex action’s current input, permission, checkout, and untrusted-PR behavior.

options.title: Pause the dependency group
options.body: Hold the whole Dependabot update if the workflow owners prefer coordinated validation of every upgraded privileged action.

recommendation.title: Split and review Codex separately
recommendation.body: Land only the routine action bumps after normal workflow validation and keep the Codex-action revision in a focused security-reviewed PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Low-confidence routing candidate for the repository-wide workflow-security choice.
